hypothesis: Swapping the exemplar bank from 12 generic hardcoded exemplars to the full 117-item domain-matched corpus should break the RAG plateau, because prior retrieval failures (exp007/008) were diagnosed as a tiny, off-domain pool problem rather than a retrieval-is-useless verdict.
technique: Semantic NLEmbedding retrieval of the k=3 nearest exemplars from a 117-item corpus of Sonnet-generated sets, injected as few-shot demonstrations into the exp011 contrastive base prompt — swapping only the exemplar bank, not the retrieval mechanism.

stages.text: Draft 7 Qs with contrastive prompt + RAG
